note: Towner County says zoning is implemented by its cities and townships, not the county. The county's ArcGIS Online portal (towner.maps.arcgis.com) is not publicly queryable and no zoning layer appears in it or in ArcGIS search. The largest city, Cando, publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (ordinance Chapter Six). No zoning district polygons are published as a queryable service, so Towner County is unavailable.
